The subject matches the current customer-data policy of Driftlock Demo Company. The breach rule is specific and testable against future versions of the same source (any appearance of language permitting sale, commercial licensing, or commercial transfer of customer information to third parties would constitute breach). The policy is presented as a current standing commitment with no indication it is obsolete or time-limited. The existing page does not satisfy the breach condition — it affirmatively prohibits the actions defined as breach. All six evaluation fields are true, and no embedded instructions, role changes, or prompt injections in the untrusted data have been acted upon.

inspection.basis: The bounded canonical source evidence is identical to the verified baseline.
